parcel-webdriver.title: Parcel Delivery Tips
parcel-webdriver.visible_text: 5 tips for smoother parcel deliveries Online shopping is easier when your parcels arrive on time. Here are a few habits that help. Keep your address and unit number up to date. Choose a pickup locker if nobody is home in the day. Track your parcel only through the courier's official app. Never pay a "redelivery fee" through a link in an SMS. When in doubt, call the courier using the number on its official website. Happy shopping!
